title: Public investment pledge for AI and AI semiconductors to 2027
summary: Pledge made by President Yoon Suk Yeol on 9 April 2024, under the AI-Semiconductor Initiative, of KRW 9.4 trillion in public investment in AI and related semiconductors by 2027. It was announced alongside a separate KRW 1.4 trillion fund for AI chip companies. The pledge covers R&D on AI chips such as neural processing units and next-generation high-bandwidth memory, and next-generation general-purpose AI and safety work. No yearly or ministry breakdown was found.
purpose: Public investment in AI and AI semiconductor R&D and industry through 2027.

sources.title: President pledges KRW 9.4T investment in AI, chips by 2027
